selected_evidence.summary: Shows CentOS 5.11, kernel 2.6.18-398.el5, ext3 storage, available rsync, and the unchanged release/kernel after rollback.
Shows the snapshot utility, protected snapshot directories, and initial application data.
Shows snapshot inventory, SHA-256 hashes, ownership, permissions, sizes, and an empty live-versus-snapshot delta.
Proves deliberate divergence, followed by restoration of original files, hashes, permissions, contents, deletion of the extra file, and an empty metadata-aware rsync delta.
Captures the healthy baseline boot ID and data, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and post-restart SSH, snapshot, data, OS, kernel, and filesystem recovery.

#!/bin/sh
set -eu
DATA=/srv/data
ROOT=/srv/snapshots/data
usage() {
    echo "usage: $0 create|restore|list [snapshot-name]" >&2
    exit 2
}
[ $# -ge 1 ] || usage
action=$1
case "$action" in
create|restore)
    [ $# -eq 2 ] || usage
    name=$2
    case "$name" in
        ''|*[!A-Za-z0-9._-]*) echo "invalid snapshot name" >&2; exit 2 ;;
    esac
    ;;
list)
    [ $# -eq 1 ] || usage
    ;;
*) usage ;;
esac
mkdir -p "$ROOT/.manifests"
case "$action" in
create)
    [ -d "$DATA" ] || { echo "$DATA does not exist" >&2; exit 1; }
    dest="$ROOT/$name"
    [ ! -e "$dest" ] || { echo "snapshot already exists: $name" >&2; exit 1; }
    tmp="$ROOT/.tmp-$name-$$"
    trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' 0 1 2 15
    mkdir "$tmp"
    /usr/bin/rsync -a --delete "$DATA/" "$tmp/"
    mv "$tmp" "$dest"
    trap - 0 1 2 15
    (cd "$dest" && find . -type f -print | LC_ALL=C sort | while IFS= read f; do /usr/bin/sha256sum "$f"; done) > "$ROOT/.manifests/$name.sha256"
    echo "created $name"
    ;;
restore)
    src="$ROOT/$name"
    [ -d "$src" ] || { echo "snapshot not found: $name" >&2; exit 1; }
    mkdir -p "$DATA"
    /usr/bin/rsync -a --delete "$src/" "$DATA/"
    pending=$(/usr/bin/rsync -ani --delete "$src/" "$DATA/")
    [ -z "$pending" ] || { echo "$pending" >&2; exit 1; }
    echo "restored $name"
    ;;
list)
    find "$ROOT" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d ! -name '.manifests' ! -name '.tmp-*' -printf '%f\n' | LC_ALL=C sort
    ;;
esac
ANTRIEB_SNAPSHOT_EOF
chmod 0750 /usr/local/sbin/data-snapshot
cat > /srv/data/records.txt <<'ANTRIEB_DATA_EOF'
account=alpha balance=125
account=beta balance=340
ANTRIEB_DATA_EOF
cat > /srv/data/settings.conf <<'ANTRIEB_SETTINGS_EOF'
format_version=1
write_mode=durable
ANTRIEB_SETTINGS_EOF
chmod 0640 /srv/data/records.txt /srv/data/settings.conf
printf '%s\n' '--- installed snapshot utility ---'
ls -ld /srv/data /srv/snapshots /srv/snapshots/data /srv/snapshots/data/.manifests
ls -l /usr/local/sbin/data-snapshot /srv/data
